subject: Renewal: MSA + Order Form — Skylark Systems capacity uplift & term change
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Chen <daniel@skylark.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skylark.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skylark renewal — MSA redlines + order form for capacity uplift

Hi Daniel / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Attached are two items to get the paperwork moving: a redline of the MSA (Skylark_MSA_v3_redline.docx) and a proposed order form showing the incremental capacity bump and revised term (OrderForm_Uplift_Skylark_20250918.pdf).

High-level summary of changes we made on the redline: 
- Term: proposal to move from 12 months to 18 months (to preserve current pricing tiers and give Skylark predictable unit pricing)
- Exhibit B: capacity schedule updated to reflect +200 GPU hours/month for the next 12 months, with staged ramp in month 1 and month 6
- Data retention clause: tightened language to keep audit logs for 12 months and added KMS integration notes
- SLA credits: clarified patch for multi-region failover; left amounts unchanged but added trigger conditions

Action items / asks from you: 
1) Confirm term preference (12 vs 18 months) and whether you need monthly or quarterly invoicing.
2) Procurement: please confirm signer and DocuSign routing (we can prep a signer sequence).
3) If legal has any specific SSO/KMS vendor requirements, flag them so we can include the vendor names in Exhibit D.

I copied our legal ops lead (Marissa) and account lead (Dev) to help triage any redline questions quickly. If it helps, we can do a 30-min handoff call today.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Counsel | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Skylark_MSA_v3_redline.docx (Word redline), OrderForm_Uplift_Skylark_20250918.pdf (proposed quantities/pricing)

From: Daniel Chen <daniel@skylark.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skylark.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylark renewal — MSA redlines + order form for capacity uplift

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the detail. A few questions from our side after a quick pass: 

- Term: Our execs prefer 12 months but are open to 18 if there is a price concession. Can you confirm: will any unit price reduce for a committed 18-month term?
- Ramp: The +200 GPU hours makes sense, but procurement needs a monthly breakdown (we need straight-line numbers for our CAPEX planning). The PDF looks aggregated — can you provide a month-by-month schedule?
- Data residency: We require logs to be retained for 18 months for compliance in our European subsidiary — is that negotiable for a carve-out in Exhibit C?
- Insurance: our legal asked about adding a certificate-of-insurance clause; could you point us to your standard language?

Also looping in our procurement contact (procurement@skylark.com) — they will want to own the DocuSign flow. If you can provide a DocuSign-ready bundle (MSA + order form, with tracked signature blocks), that will speed sign-off.

Happy to jump on a call Friday afternoon if that works for your team.

Best,
Daniel
Head of IT Procurement | Skylark Systems
daniel@skylark.com

Team — quick internal note after reading Daniel's questions: 

Summary of Daniel's asks: 
- Confirm whether we offer a price break for 18-month committed term. (Sales)
- Provide month-by-month capacity schedule instead of aggregated table. (Sales/AM)
- Consider 18-month log retention carve-out for EU subsidiary. (Legal/Compliance)
- Provide COI clause or standard insurance language. (Legal/Finance)

Proposed owners and next steps: 
- Sales (Dev): confirm pricing concession for 18-month term and prepare two order form variants (12-month and 18-month with price delta). Target: EOD Fri 9/19.
- Legal (me + Soojin): draft EU carve-out language for Exhibit C and attach an addendum clause; confirm COI language and send standard wording. Target: Morning Mon 9/22.
- Ops (Lauren): convert the aggregate PDF into a month-by-month CSV + updated order form. Target: EOD Thu 9/18 (I know this is tight; Lauren please confirm).

Subject: Re: Skylark renewal — MSA redlines + order form for capacity uplift (DocuSign bundle)

Hi Daniel / Procurement,

Thanks for the quick notes. Per our internal owners: 
- Dev confirmed there's a 4% unit price reduction for an 18-month committed term versus 12 months. See attached OrderForm_Uplift_Skylark_20250918_v2.pdf (month-by-month schedule added).
- Marissa and I drafted an EU carve-out for Exhibit C to extend audit log retention to 18 months for Skylark's EU subsidiary. We'll include that as an addendum so the core MSA doesn't change region-wide.
- COI: attaching standard insurance clause language and a sample COI we can provide once countersigned.

Next steps I will take this afternoon: prepare a DocuSign-ready bundle (MSA redline + order form v2 + addendum) and send to procurement@skylark.com with signature sequencing. If procurement confirms the signer list, we will route accordingly.

Please confirm: signer for Skylark will be either Alicia Park (Legal) or Tobias Myers (CFO)? Also confirm whether billing should be monthly or quarterly.

If those two items are confirmed, we can aim for a signed agreement next week. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that speeds up routing.

Thanks —

--
Soojin Lee
